original_test_intent: Read the CRPS latch-on-fault configuration field that encodes the byte offset from the current configuration block to the next block, then compare the decoded value with the applicable PSU vendor layout.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Verify the SUT configuration; the test step states: offset in bytes from this location to the beginning of the next configuration block; collect results/photos and inspect logs.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Offset in bytes from this location to the beginning of the next configuration block.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED because the field map, byte order, expected offset, safe read tool, and recovery were absent.
historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with read-only identity collection and a prohibition on guessed PMBus access.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: The PSU/platform engineer supplies and approves the proprietary specification and decoder; the approved readback can then be agent-executed.
required_user_inputs: CRPS model, slot, serial and firmware/VPD identity
Field address, current/next block boundaries, byte order, encoding and expected offset

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: The master identifies the offset relationship and 5/5-minute planning values but supplies no model-specific numeric offset or command.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Bind the exact CRPS/firmware, field definition, expected value and read-only vendor method.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: No project run exists; CRPS identity inventory alone would not cover the offset decode/comparison.

original_method: Use a PSU vendor configuration-block/VPD decoder and compare the offset against the printed vendor table. No executable source command is present.

modernized_recommendation.reason: The vendor-defined read-only decoder remains the only defensible method; no public generic substitute can establish the proprietary block layout.

missing_inputs: Model-specific field map and expected numeric offset
safety_boundaries: Do not blind-scan PMBus/SMBus or guess a register/address.
Do not write configuration, reset or flash the PSU.
Preserve existing BMC/SEL evidence rather than clearing logs.
expected_evidence: Raw field/block bytes, byte order, decoded offset and block boundaries
Timestamped readback and preserved BMC/SEL state
no_automatic_retry: Any failed or ambiguous read is retained. Do not change the command, scan another address, reset the PSU, or retry without a new approved plan.
engineer_owned_verdict: The agent may report the raw and decoded values and their difference from the approved reference; only the engineer assigns formal PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
review_improvement: KEEP because V3 already converted the missing proprietary artifact from a permanent blocker into explicit readiness gates while preserving the no-guess safety boundary. V3.1 adds only the master/project parameter separation and does not change the technical conclusion.
